verses.text: Ha ix yune' ix Lea yet' winhaj Jacob, haton ix Dina, ix b'at ix paxyal t'a skal heb' ix ix t'a Siquem chi'.
Ha winhaj Hamor heveo, yajal yaj t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Siquem. Ayik ix yilanoch ix Dina winhaj Siquem chi', ix ixtaj ix yuj winh t'a ak'b'il puralil.
Yujto te ay snib'ej winh t'a ix, yuj chi' ix montaj ix yuj winh t'a wach'il.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh smam chi': --Mamin, oktom b'at a k'an jun ix kob'es tik. In gana swik' in b'a yet' ix, xchi winh.

Wach'chom ix yab' winhaj Jacob to toxo ix ixtaj ix yisil winh yuj winhaj Siquem chi', malaj tas ix yal winh masanto ix jax heb' yuninal winh tanhwoj kalnel. Ha ix yab'an heb' winh yuninal winh chi' tas ix uji, ix meltzajkot heb' winh, ix te kus heb' winh. Ix kotpax yowal heb' winh, yujto te q'uixwelal ix utaj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Israel, haton winhaj Jacob, yuj winhaj Siquem chi', yujto ix ixtaj ix yisil winh. Manh wach'ok tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Siquem chi'. Haxo winhaj Hamor chi' ix b'at lolon yet' winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix lolonpax winh yet' heb' yuninal winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh wuninal aj Siquem te ay wal snib'ej winh t'a ix eyanab', yuj chi' elokab' t'a he k'ool yik syik'laj sb'a ix yet' winh.
Ichato ol ko k'ab'kokej ko b'a. Ol kik'laj ko b'a yet' heb' ix eyisil, a ex xo ol eyik'laj he b'a yet' heb' ix kiko'.
Kajnajanhek t'a ko kal tik, kolan tzex aj t'a sat ko lu'um tik, ak'ekoch he chonh, manek he lu'um, xchi winhaj Hamor chi'.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Siquem chi' t'a winh smam ix Dina chi' yet' t'a heb' winh snulej ix: --Yalnhej tas tze k'an t'ayin ol wak' t'ayex.
Wach'chom niwan tas swak' t'a yib'anh tas syak'taxon heb' anima yet' pax tzijtumok silab' syal wak'ani, palta malaj tz'ochi, anhej tato scha he k'ool swik' in b'a yet' ix, xchi winhaj Siquem chi'.
Yujto toxo ix yixtej ix yanab' heb' winh chi' winh, ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a chab'satil t'a winh yet' t'a smam winh chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Max yal kak'an ix kanab' tik t'a junok winak to manh ak'b'ilok circuncidar, q'uixwelal tzonh ajkan icha chi'.
Anhej tato scha he k'ol icha kaj a onh tik, tekan am skak' ix t'ayex, yujto a onh tik, circuncidado onh. Tato syal he k'ool tzex ak'ji circuncidar yet' masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a he kal chi',
ichato chi' syal eyik'an heb' ix kisil a onh tik, syalpax kik'an heb' ix eyiko'. Ichato chi' syal kaj t'a he kal, junxonhej chonhab'il tzonh aj heyet'ok.
Tato max scha he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej jun circuncisión chi' jun, ol onh el t'a tik, ol kik'anb'at ix kanab' tik ket'ok, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix scha sk'ool winhaj Hamor yet' winh yuninal tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.
Majxo ek' wal niwan tiempo, yujto ay snib'ej winh t'a ix yisil winhaj Jacob chi'. Ha winhaj Siquem chi' anhej winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor yet' t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
T'a elanhchamel ix b'at winh yet' winh smam chi' t'a spuertail chonhab' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, ix och ijan heb' yalan icha tik t'a heb' winh winak:

--Ha juntzanh winak tik wach' spensar heb', ol kajnaj heb' t'a ko kal tik, ol yak'anoch schonh heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Te ay lum lum b'aj wach' yaj heb' winh. Syal kik'an ko b'a yet' heb' ix yisil heb' winh, syalpax yik'an sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix kiko'.
Anhej to snib'ej heb' winh to ko masanil a onh winak onh tik, sko cha jun circuncisión icha yaj heb' winh, icha chi' junnhej chonhab'il tzonh aj yet' heb' winh.

Ha masanil stastak heb' winh yet' masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh, kikxo smasanil, anhej tato sko tak'wej t'a heb' winh, yik wach' skan heb' winh t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Hamor yet' winhaj Siquem chi'.
Masanil heb' winh tz'akanxo spensar ix scha sk'ol heb' winh tas ix yal heb' chawanh chi', yuj chi' ix ak'ji circuncidar heb' winh masanil.

Haxo winhaj Simeón yet' winhaj Leví, yuninal winhaj Jacob, snulej ix Dina chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' chi' t'a schab'jial. Yakb'an yato ay heb' winh winak chi' yuj b'aj ix ak'ji circuncidar chi', ix k'och heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ix och ijan heb' winh smilancham heb' winh ya yaj chi' smasanil t'a k'een espada, yujto manh naanok yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi'.
Ix miljicham winhaj Hamor yet' winhaj Siquem yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta ix Dina heb' winh t'a yol spat winhaj Siquem chi', ix paxta heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och masanil heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj spaktzitan heb' winh yuj b'aj ix ixtaj ix yanab' chi'.
Masanil tas ay t'a yol chonhab' chi' yet' tas ayel t'a najat ix yik'b'at heb' winh, nok' kalnel, nok' wakax yet' nok' b'uru.
Ix yelk'anb'at heb' winh masanil tas ay t'a yoltak pat, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ix ix yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a winhaj Simeón yet' t'a winhaj Leví chi' icha tik: --Tik wal a ex tzeyak' somchajel in k'ool. Ha tiknaik, masanil heb' winh kajan t'a juntzanh lugar tik, haton masanil heb' winh cananeo yet' heb' winh ferezeo, ol te och chian sk'ool heb' winh t'ayonh. Tekan ol smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh, ol yak'an owal heb' winh ket'ok. Jaywannhej ko winak ayek' ket'ok, tekan ol onh smilcham heb' winh ko masanil, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom ay sleyal syixtej ix kanab' tik winh, syutan ix winh icha junok ix ajmul ix? xchi heb' winh.
